title: Revert application to Version 38

requirements.text: Revert the entire application (frontend and backend) to the state it was in at Version 38, undoing all changes introduced in Version 39.

quotes: can you revert to version 38, version 39 still buggy

acceptanceCriteria: All frontend files reflect the Version 38 state, not Version 39.
All backend files reflect the Version 38 state, not Version 39.
None of the changes introduced in Version 39 are present in the deployed application.
The application builds and deploys successfully from the Version 38 codebase.

constraints: Do not include any changes from Version 39 or Version 40.
Restore to exactly Version 38 — do not introduce new features or fixes during the revert.
nonGoals: Introducing any new features or improvements beyond restoring Version 38.
Preserving any Version 39 or Version 40 changes.
